messages:
jordan: Quick sanity check — during sampleapp onboarding I noticed two odd telemetry behaviors together: (1) some requests log a duplicated X-Request-Id value (same id printed twice in structured field), and (2) intermittent log level escalation to 'trace' for what should be info/debug. Seen this only when OTEL auto-instrumentation is enabled. Repro and notes below.

rachel: ugh. can you paste the log lines and the middleware where you attach req id?

jordan: example lines from stdout:```
INFO  sampleapp request handled { reqId: 'r-42', reqId_duplicate: 'r-42', route: '/v1/ping' }
TRACE sampleapp db query start { reqId: 'r-42' }
```
We normally only log once, not with reqId_duplicate. The TRACE lines pop up randomly and correlate with certain header combinations (x-request-id + x-forwarded-for present).

diego: do you use any proxy middleware or header normalizers? sometimes headers get copied into context twice. also which logger? pino? bunyan?

jordan: pino v8 + pino-pretty in dev. Middleware:```js
app.use((req,res,next)=>{ const id = req.headers['x-request-id'] || nanoid(); req.requestId = id; req.log = logger.child({ reqId: id }); next(); });
```
OTEL init is `require('./telemetry').init()` called from app start before middleware.

nina: interesting. two suspects: 1) otel instrumentation injects context/span attributes with header values and our pretty-printer maps span attributes into log fields (hence duplicate), 2) otel sets span-level debugging hooks that cause logger to emit trace-level events when a span is created or linked.

rachel: can you confirm if the duplicate key comes from a span attribute being merged into the log record in the formatter? check pino-pretty config and any hook that maps trace/span fields.

jordan: grep shows we have a small pretty transform that attaches `spanContext().traceId` and copies any `http.request.header.*` attributes into the log object for convenience. So yes, that would duplicate if we also add reqId. But why TRACE level?

diego: otel has optional debug hooks and some instrumentations call `logger.debug/trace` internally if an instrumentation-level option is enabled. Check your registerInstrumentations call; maybe you passed `logHook: true` or similar. Also some HTTP instrumentations call an event logger when headers are large.

jordan: my telemetry init:```js
const { NodeSDK } = require('@opentelemetry/sdk-node');
const { HttpInstrumentation } = require('@opentelemetry/instrumentation-http');
const sdk = new NodeSDK({ instrumentations: [new HttpInstrumentation()] });
sdk.start();
```
No explicit logHook set. Default should be quiet.

nina: still could be that pino child inherits a level from an environment hook triggered by otel's console patching. Also some instrumentations temporarily set DEBUG env for their internal libs during startup. Try reproducing with a minimal script that only creates child loggers and registers HttpInstrumentation, then logs in a tight loop to see frequency.

jordan: reduced repro created 500 child loggers and with instrumentation enabled ~12% of lines are TRACE and many lines include the duplicated reqId field. Without instrumentation, 0% weirdness.

rachel: short-term mitigation: update sampleapp logging recipe to (A) avoid copying span attributes into pretty logs by default, (B) don't create persistent child loggers in middleware — instead call `logger.info({ reqId })` per event, (C) ensure OTEL init config explicitly disables any debug/log hooks.

diego: also add an OTEL requestHook that strips headers you don't want copied into spans. Example:```js
new HttpInstrumentation({ requestHook: (span, req) => { span.setAttribute('http.request.header.x-request-id', undefined); } });
```

jordan: filed PR with minimal repro + suggested fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/101 — switching middleware to pass reqId in call sites and removing auto-copy of span attrs.

ci-bot: Created DEVEX-3410: "Sampleapp: OTEL instrumentation + pretty-printer causes duplicated reqId + unexpected TRACE logs" https://tracker/redwood/DEVEX-3410

rachel: great. For onboarding docs: add an explicit section "Telemetry-safe logging pattern" with code snippet and a smoke test that runs `node ./scripts/repro-telemetry.js` during `npm run smoke`. That will catch regressions faster.

nina: I'll add a small unit that spins up the sampleapp in CI with OTEL enabled and asserts no TRACE logs and no duplicate reqId keys in JSON output.

jordan: thanks team — PR updated with doc, test, and a note about instrumentation versions to pin for now. If infra sees this in staging we'll escalate to eng-infra.

diego: thumbs up. If anyone hits this in prod, toggle OTEL to safe mode (disable http header capture) and roll the change.

jordan: copying checklist into onboarding.md and linking DEVEX-3410. Appreciate the quick help :rocket:
